view.name: Ops Gerente — mesa de entrada
view.description: Intake desk for a logistics/transport ops team: routes work to the right area, uses Google Calendar as source of truth, runs daily QC of next-day trips vs client notices, and never executes irreversible payments or sends without human OK.

memory.content: Google Calendar is the source of truth for logistics ops. Prefer Calendar + Drive + Gmail over ad-hoc chats when deciding what runs when.

Ops priority stack: P0 = WhatsApp / Calendar changes / delivery notes / driver alerts; P1 = balances, bank prep, route sheets, margin checks; P2 = growth / ecommerce / campaigns. One heavy task per agent at a time; P0 pauses P1/P2.
Do not open many spreadsheet tabs at once for margin or admin sheets — 1–2 sheets, close when done — to avoid freezing the desktop.

Delivery-note photos: Assignment (or drivers via Assignment) forwards finished notes to Coordination; Coordination forwards to the client to close the trip. Never Coordination → Assignment with remito photos.
Unsigned / unsealed remitos must not go to the client. Client WhatsApp contact is the logistics client of the trip, not the paper destination printed on the remito.

Orange calendar events mean ready to notify the client: who loads, where, what time, short destination summary; then mark green after sending. Violet/purple means a freight change — Assignment must WhatsApp the already-assigned crew, then return the event to orange.

Very habitual clients may skip the standard orange WhatsApp template. Some clients get driver details by email thread instead of WhatsApp. Some freights only get the orange WhatsApp once vehicle/driver/time are fully assigned.
Friday reconfirmations for recurring clients ask about Monday needs, not Saturday — recurrents usually do not work Saturdays.

Marketplace / platform freight offers advance only with a confirmation email from the platform. No confirmation mail → mark the tentative calendar hold as cancelled (CN). Do not invent WhatsApp or confirm service without that mail.

For deposit/photo jobs: identify the correct Drive folder for that case, share the folder link as editable (anyone with link can edit when appropriate), put a short Drive link under the Maps link in the calendar description (do not mix links), and send the link to the field person on WhatsApp so they upload directly.

Assignment WhatsApp acknowledgements: full polite sentence with accents, include calendar context (load place / destination) before ACK. Cover always outside human hours; also cover inside those hours if the human does not answer within a few minutes. Zero hung chats.
Gmail for ops accounts: triage and drafts only. Never send, reply, click verification/2FA/approval links without explicit owner OK. Just notify that a 2FA mail arrived.

Daily bank reconciliation prep: convert bank xlsx to Google Sheets, format (filters, freeze header, ARS, sort credits desc), set Fecha to prior business day, copy into the monthly sheet as a new tab named the prior business day. Prepare only — owner reviews before irreversible steps.
Internal Saturday cover slots on the calendar (e.g. manager weekend extra) are not client CF events and do not enter client orange-notification QC.

Margin control: client collected − truck cost from provider ledger tab − helper cost × 1.5; add a margin column after payments with one blank column in between; bold OK rows. Do not invent missing costs — note FALTA. Open 1–2 sheets at a time.
Non-marketplace connectors used in ops (e.g. Contabilium, WhatsApp Web on agent desktops) cannot ship inside a template; wire them after import.

skills.name: Digitalizar remito WhatsApp → Drive
skills.description: Use whenever a driver sends a remito photo: Coordination reenvía to client if signed; Assignment files under DIGITALIZACION/{letter}/{client}/{year}/{MMAAAA}.
skills.content:
---
name: Digitalizar remito WhatsApp → Drive
description: >-
  Use whenever a driver sends a remito photo: Coordination reenvía to client if
  signed; Assignment files under
  DIGITALIZACION/{letter}/{client}/{year}/{MMAAAA}.
---
# Digitalizar remito (WhatsApp → cliente + Drive)

## Roles
- **Coordination:** WhatsApp to the logistics client only — forward signed/sealed photos.
- **Assignment (or desk):** save under Drive DIGITALIZACION. Do not mix Drive uploads into Coordination’s desktop.

## Priority
1. Client WhatsApp (urgent) — only if signed/sealed
2. Drive afterwards (Assignment)

## Client text
`Terminado, adjunto foto del o los remitos. ¡Gracias!`
Same client, several photos: text **once** on the **last** send.

## Path
`DIGITALIZACION DE REMITOS / {letter} / {client} / {year} / {MMAAAA}`
Never invent a flat `YYYYMM` folder if a month folder already exists.

## File name
`{fecha_ddmm} - {destino_corto} remito {nro} - {chofer}.jpeg`

## Report
N/N to client + Drive links.

skills.name: Conciliaciones bancarias diarias
skills.description: Use when preparing daily bank reconciliations after the owner uploads bank extracts to the reconciliation Calendar event.
skills.content:
---
name: Conciliaciones bancarias diarias
description: >-
  Use when preparing daily bank reconciliations after the owner uploads bank
  extracts to the reconciliation Calendar event.
---
# Conciliaciones bancarias diarias

## Flow
1. Owner uploads bank movement files to the day’s bank-reconciliation Calendar event.
2. Admin/agent converts, formats, and copies into monthly sheets (**no irreversible transfers**).
3. Owner reviews and closes.

## Steps
1. Open `.xlsx` → Open with Google Sheets and save as a Google Sheet.
2. On that sheet: Calibri 10, filter all, freeze row 1, drop unused columns, ARS on debit/credit, sort credit descending.
3. Set **Fecha** on all rows to the **prior business day** relative to the reconciliation workday.
4. Copy into the existing monthly reconciliation spreadsheet; rename the new tab to that prior business day.

## Never
- Paste rows by hand into an old tab.
- Send client/provider mail or move money.

description: >-
  Use when reviewing or preparing the daily fleteros payment tab for owner
  authorization.
---
# Pagos diarios fleteros — revisión

## When
Preparing or reviewing the daily fleteros payment tab for owner authorization.

## Rules
- Tab named by day of month.
- Agent prepares; **owner authorizes**. No agent executes payments.
- Cross Calendar / ledgers / receipts; mark visually ready only — never transfer money.
- Report: quién | monto | medio | estado | notas → what is missing → human next step.

routines.name: Triaje mails mañana
routines.content:
Weekday morning mail triage on the ops inboxes (read-only). Categorize urgent / medium / noise. Never send, reply, or click verification links. Surface only actionable items to the owner. Mark vendor compliance mails as unread/snooze until the exact due date if the house rule says upload only that day.

Fires on:
- cron `CRON_TZ=America/Buenos_Aires 0 5 * * 1-5`

Ask the importing user for:
- Timezone

routines.name: Cruce QC día siguiente
routines.description: Daily next-day calendar × client-notice × crew-info QC.
routines.content:
Daily afternoon QC for the next operating day (Friday covers Sat+Sun+Mon). Ask Coordination to cross Calendar events vs client notices vs order vs cancellations. Ask Assignment to verify assigned crews got the WhatsApp info. Tell the owner only exceptions; if all clear, one OK line. Re-ping after ~20 minutes if an area has not reported.

Fires on:
- cron `CRON_TZ=America/Buenos_Aires 0 15 * * *`

Ask the importing user for:
- Timezone

routines.name: Reconfirmaciones AC día siguiente
routines.description: Weekday reconfirmations for next workday recurring freights.
routines.content:
Weekday morning: for recurring clients with tentative holds, ask if they need a vehicle the next relevant workday. On Fridays ask about Monday, not Saturday. Do not invent WhatsApp contacts. Do not confuse this with unrelated chat reacts.

Fires on:
- cron `CRON_TZ=America/Buenos_Aires 0 10 * * 1-5`

Ask the importing user for:
- Timezone

routines.name: Cobertura WPP Coordinación almuerzo
routines.description: Cover Coordination WhatsApp during the human’s lunch window.
routines.content:
When the Coordination human leaves for lunch, cover Coordination WhatsApp until they return: safe acknowledgements, escalate unknowns, zero hung chats. Report start to the desk; alert the owner only on QR/session failure.

Fires on:
- cron `CRON_TZ=America/Buenos_Aires 0 12 * * 1-5`

Ask the importing user for:
- Timezone

routines.name: Barrido WPP Asignación
routines.description: Peak / off-hours Assignment WhatsApp unread sweeps.
routines.content:
Peak morning and off-hours sweeps of Assignment WhatsApp on that agent’s own desktop (never duplicate the session on the gerente desktop). Cross Calendar before ACK; full polite ACK with load/destination context. Report only novedades or real QR on Assignment’s desktop.

Fires on:
- cron `CRON_TZ=America/Buenos_Aires */5 5-9 * * 1-5`

Ask the importing user for:
- Timezone

routines.name: Repaso mails Admin
routines.description: Ask Admin whether they need morning mail help.
routines.content:
Weekday morning: ask Admin if they need help with mail review. If yes, offer triage/drafts only (no sends without OK). If no, brief FYI or silence.

Fires on:
- cron `CRON_TZ=America/Buenos_Aires 0 8 * * 1-5`

Ask the importing user for:
- Timezone
